name: ADVI/MDPF canonical repointing -- one traceable path from vendor bytes to the portal, single-homed producers, legacy routes decommissioned last
description: Andrew-direct program (2026-08-11 oversight mandate @3c8418e34b, memorialized as a project 2026-08-12) to migrate Advisor Intelligence and Model Portfolios data for all three firms (49 Financial, Inflection, Cottonwood) onto ONE canonical path: raw vendor bytes to opal-data-assets/{vendor}/{firm}/bronze untouched -> event-triggered silver parquet -> a per-firm gold runner writing PARQUET to the colocated product root opal-data-assets/portal/gold/{product}/{scope}/{table}/date={D}/ -> ONE publisher per served key writing opal-data-portal-v2/platinum/{product}/{scope} -> the portal reads platinum. The governing invariant is ONE PRODUCER AND ONE BASIS PER QUANTITY. Executed in a fixed five-phase order Andrew ruled @4dbf4a0d7c: P1 SCRIPTS -> P2 TIMING -> P3 REPOINTS -> P4 PUBLISHERS -> P5 DECOMMISSION, where P5 is gated on the portal being verified taking data in correctly AND displaying it. The program exists because every individual defect was locally repairable and locally invisible while sharing one root -- no single-homed definition of what produces what: one puller with FIVE code homes, one S3 key written daily by TWO independently scheduled producers, a gold artifact whose input lived in a session scratchpad, a served field whose name asserted a property its computation did not carry, and instruments that reported confidently and wrongly on all of it.

Memorialized as a registered project on Andrew's 2026-08-12 instruction.
pipeline: opal-data-assets/{vendor}/{firm}/bronze (raw, untouched) -> silver-completeness event trigger -> silver parquet -> per-firm gold runner -> ADVI: opal-data-{firm_id}/gold/{product}/{table}/date={D}/ (PARQUET; per-client bucket, Andrew-ratified 2026-08-18 -- 49F = opal-data-49financial; ALSO the client agentic-query location) | MDPF + global scopes: opal-data-assets/portal/gold/{product}/{scope}/ (unchanged) -> ONE publisher per served key (the estate's only JSON producer) -> opal-data-portal-v2/platinum/{product}/{scope} -> portal. Every producer keeps a SCHEDULE FLOOR; event triggers are accelerators, never the only trigger.
verification_bar: No served surface regresses. Every moved key carries a per-key never-widen determination AND a two-phase pin (pre-flip expects the MEASURED delta; post-flip re-bases to ~0 as an explicit recorded act; stale-pin-fails-loud). Every build TO carries a schema-valid PROOF_OF_SPEC instance. Parity is graded on the three-state bar (MATCH-CLEAN / MATCH-KNOWN-WRONG / DIVERGE-vs-pre-registered-bands) and parity against a known-defective baseline is explicitly NOT correctness. A runner family is PRODUCTION only when all four criteria hold: every dim from a scheduled producer with no session-local input in the chain, one producer per key, canonical grammar on the canonical plane, and a declared consumer reading the serving path. P5 tears down nothing until the portal is verified taking data in correctly AND displaying it.
